summary: No reachable vulnerability. The game-type radios' onChange closes over the literal from the fixed GAME_TYPES array (setGameType(value)), never reading event.target.value, so a devtools-tampered value attribute cannot inject an arbitrary game type. Start game builds the config via configForGameType, which emits a stake only for 'cash' and otherwise a stake-less SitAndGoSessionConfig, so no stake reaches the session/engine for a sit-and-go; resolveSessionConfig applies the same normalisation. Chip amounts are compile-time constants (1500 start, 20/40 level-1 limits via a frozen Stake) and the cash stake still comes from the existing CASH_STAKES select. No persistence, URL params, JSON.parse or other untrusted config source exists in src (the only seatSession caller is useTableSession with the in-memory config). Sit-and-go header and action bar use plain chips; '$' appears only on the cash branch; no real-money wording added. No new dependencies, network, randomness or secrets.
